set.body: Acceptance criteria: finite-iteration Sinkhorn is exposed under an interface satisfied for every successful configuration, with a discriminator including the one-iteration asymmetric fixture; no default-only law run certifies broader constructors; oracle digests identify the actual pinned detector and Engbert reference files; the checked-in scientific validation JSON is generated and drift-checked from canonical typed evidence, and release build identity is explicit without a self-referential commit claim.
set.title: Make all comparisons law-honest and bind validation artifacts
